newsitem.title: UK: Saatchi & Saatchi wins Schweppes account.
newsitem.headline: Saatchi & Saatchi wins Schweppes account.

text.p: Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising said on Wednesday it had landed the account for a $20 million, pan-European advertising campaign for Schweppes Europe, the soft drinks company.

"It's a brilliant win. It's very exciting for the agency," Charles Fallon, a Saatchi & Saatchi spokesman, told Reuters. "It's a very large business win because it's not just Europe, it's one of the world's best known brands."
Saatchi & Saatchi, owned by Cordiant Plc, had had the Schweppes account previously but lost it in the early 1990s to BMP.

The 1997 ad campaign for Schweppes Europe, part of Cadbury Schweppes, will include all of the company's drinks mixes, such as tonic water and bitter lemon, its sodas and lemonades. It will not include Oasis, which is a stand-alone brand.
"The purpose is to position Schweppes as a mainstream softdrinks brand," Fallon said of the planned Europe-wide ad campaign. "It's producing a brand campaign so people understand what Schweppes is."
Saatchi & Saatchi already handles advertising for Schweppes' Oasis, Sunkist and Malvern brands.
